# ILogger interface

The logger contract shared across `@imqueue` — the four console methods, and nothing else.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface ILogger 
```

## Remarks

Deliberately console-shaped, so `console` itself satisfies it and any `@imqueue` component taking a logger accepts either that or a [Logger](/api/async-logger/latest/async-logger.logger/) with no adapter. Implement it to route the framework's own output elsewhere.
